definitions: Signals or prompts given to an actor or performer to indicate when it is their turn to speak or act.
Hints or indications about how to behave or what to do.
Sticks used to strike the cue ball in billiards, pool, or snooker.
examples: The director gave the actors their cues.
She picked up on his non-verbal cues.
He chalked his cues before the game.
